title: adhatoda zeylanica
intro: Adhatoda zeylanica, commonly known as Neem or Vasa, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries and is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda zeylanica include expectorant, bronchodilator, and anti-tussive effects, making it a popular remedy for respiratory disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like vasicine and vasicinone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
